name: Packing List
description: A smart packing list built from your days, kind of trip and plans, with quantities, sections and progress until your bag is ready.
prompt: A packing list generator: choose days, kind of trip and plans like flying, a baby or a dog, and get a checklist by section with quantities, progress, extra items and remaking the list.
author: gonzaroman
